big_story.story_title: How Kevin Warsh is rewiring the Fed
big_story.angle: Warsh's appointment signals a structural shift in Fed philosophy—from data-dependent gradualism to something faster and more reactive. What does that mean for rate cuts, inflation credibility, and the bond market's faith in the institution?

quick_hits.angle: Monday.com beat earnings but tanked on guidance—a textbook case of the market punishing 'we're growing but not fast enough' in SaaS.
Berkshire Hathaway finally stopped the equity bloodbath after 14 straight quarters of selling—either Buffett sees value again or he's just out of dry powder.
Meta open-sourcing its flagship AI model is a calculated flex at OpenAI and Anthropic—but open-source doesn't mean free from liability.
Embraer is eating Boeing and Airbus's lunch on earnings and backlog—regional jets are having a moment while the big boys stumble.

odd_thing.joke_angle: Steam's hardware shipper got breached and leaked customer names and addresses—so now your gaming PC peripherals come with a side of identity theft.
